title: Ad Astra: Fatal's QoL Crafting
description: Adds compatibility between Fatal’s QoL Crafting and Ad Astra
body:
Add compatibility between [Fatal's QoL Crafting](https://modrinth.com/mod/fatals-qol-crafting) and [Ad Astra](https://modrinth.com/mod/ad-astra).

- Stair recipe gives 8 instead of 4
- Stairs and slabs can be crafted back to full blocks
- Create stones can be used in stone crafting recipes

Full recipe list: https://www.notion.so/fatalmistake02/Recipes-275f9c81abac81a4827cdd7b0b50ed30?source=copy_link

[Fatal's QoL Crafting](https://modrinth.com/mod/fatals-qol-crafting)(Version 1.1.0 or higher) and [Ad Astra](https://modrinth.com/mod/ad-astra) are required

Made with [MCreator](https://mcreator.net/)
